text.h02: [giggles] Hehe, I'm so happy! Here — handshake!
text.h03: [curious] …Huh, your hand's cold. [softly] Was it cold outside?
text.h04a: [softly] You waited in line all this time? [warmly] …Then I'll warm you up.
text.h04b: [chuckles softly] …Heh, I know. [playful] So, as a reward, I'll warm you up.
text.h07: [whispers] …Hey. You were in another member's line earlier, weren't you?
text.h08: [whispers] …I saw. From up on the stage. The whole time.
text.h09b: [chuckles softly] …Heh, so honest. …Fine. [softly] I forgive you.
text.h10a: [playful] …Nope. [whispers] I'm not letting you go yet.
text.h10b: [playful] Huh, you're not letting go? …Heh. [chuckles softly] You're the one who doesn't want to.
text.h11: [whispers] …Next time, only stand in my line.
text.h12: [whispers] Promise. …Break it, and I'll scold you right in your ear again.
